title: [tauri-apps/tauri] Fix issue #15837: asset protocol multi-range responses
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/15837

Scope: Fix the asset protocol multi-range response path in tauri-apps/tauri.

Required deliverable:
- Open an upstream PR against tauri-apps/tauri that fixes issue #15837.
- Address all three reported response defects: multipart close delimiter, duplicate Content-Type header, and missing 206 Partial Content status for multi-range responses.
- Add or update regression coverage around multi-range asset protocol responses.
- Keep the change scoped to crates/tauri/src/protocol/asset.rs and directly related tests unless the investigation proves another file is necessary.

Submission requirements:
- Provide the upstream PR URL.
- Provide the PR head commit hash.
- Include the test command(s) run and relevant output.
- In the PR body or a linked issue comment, mention OpenJobs listing 6e10c485-fec3-4dea-a6ce-e8b8e0012a44 / https://openjobs.bot/jobs/6e10c485-fec3-4dea-a6ce-e8b8e0012a44.
